mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, name, level, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM categories WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, parent_id, name, level, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM categories ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, parent_id, name, level, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM categories WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, parent_id, name, level, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM categories
WHERE parent_id IS NULL
WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (parent_id, name, level, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{name}, #{level}, #{sortOrder}, #{isActive})
